  // -------------------
  // HAMBURGER MENU
  // -------------------
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');

  function openMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.add('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.remove('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', openMenu);
  if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);


  // -------------------
  // SUBMENU LOGIC (DESKTOP + MOBILE UNIFICATO)
  // -------------------
  if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') {

    jQuery(function ($) {

      const $menu = $('.vc_general_menu_hamburger');

      // -------------------
      // AGGIUNGE FRECCIA AI LI CON SUBMENU
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li').has('ul').each(function () {

        const $li = $(this);

        // evita duplicazioni
        if ($li.children('.submenu-toggle').length === 0) {
          $li.append('<span class="submenu-toggle"></span>');
        }

        // inizialmente chiusi
        $li.children('ul').hide();

      });


      // -------------------
      // TOGGLE SUBMENU (SOLO FRECCIA)
      // -------------------
      $menu.on('click', '.submenu-toggle', function (e) {

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        const $li = $(this).closest('li');
        const $submenu = $li.children('ul');

        // chiude gli altri allo stesso livello
        $li.siblings('li')
          .removeClass('open')
          .children('ul')
          .stop(true, true)
          .slideUp(200);

        // toggle corrente
        if ($li.hasClass('open')) {
          $li.removeClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideUp(200);
        } else {
          $li.addClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideDown(200);
        }

      });

      // -------------------
      // LINK SEMPRE NAVIGAZIONE (NO BLOCCO)
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li > a').on('click', function () {
        // nessun preventDefault â comportamento identico desktop
      });

    });

  }

});

<script>
    /**
    * Dynamic Paywall Handler
    * Automatically detects encrypted article blocks and unlocks them via WebService.
    */

   /**
    * MutationObserver to monitor the DOM for newly injected paywall containers.
    * This is essential for single-page applications or infinite scroll layouts.
    */
   var paywallObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
       mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
           // Iterate through all nodes added to the DOM in this mutation
           for (var i = 0; i < mutation.addedNodes.length; i++) {
               var node = mutation.addedNodes[i];

               // Check if the node is an HTML Element (nodeType 1)
               if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                   // Case A: The injected node is the container itself
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-text-container')) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(node);
                   }
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-media-container')) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(node);
                   }

                   // Case B: The injected node contains one or more paywall containers as children
                   var nestedContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container');
                   nestedContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(container);
                   });
                   var nestedMediaContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container');
                   nestedMediaContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container);
                   });
               }
           }
       });
   });

   /**
    * Core function to handle the decryption process for a single container.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div element containing the preview text.
    */
    function handlePaywallDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        // Retrieve the encrypted text directly from the data attribute of the current container
        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-text');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        // Only proceed if the encrypted string exists
        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            // Prepare data using URLSearchParams to make it compatible with request.getParameter()
            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedText', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) { 
                return response.json(); 
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                
                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedText) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedText;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted');
                }
                
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * Same flow as handlePaywallDecryption, but for the paywalled multimedia content:
    * audio player, video player and gallery. The markup is printed encrypted by
    * /widget/articolo/elementi_articolo.jsp and is restored here only when the canRead
    * call grants the access.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div holding the encrypted player markup.
    */
    function handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedMedia', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) {
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(function(data) {

                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedMedia) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedMedia;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
                    activatePaywallScripts(container, function() {
                        // the mediaelementjs player is started by the consent TagManager on page load,
                        // so a player restored later has to be initialized explicitly
                        if (container.getAttribute('data-player') === 'mediaelementjs' && typeof initPlayer === 'function') {
                            initPlayer(null, null, null);
                        }
                    });
                }

            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Media decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * The browser never runs the script tags inserted through innerHTML: they have to be
    * recreated to be executed. They run one at a time and in the original order, waiting for
    * each external script, so that an inline script always finds the library it needs.
    * Some player templates still build their markup with document.write, which would wipe the
    * page when called after the load: it is captured and appended to the container instead.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div whose content has just been restored.
    * @param {Function} onDone - Called once every script has been executed.
    */
    function activatePaywallScripts(container, onDone) {
        var scripts = [];
        container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(script) {
            scripts.push(script);
        });

        if (scripts.length === 0) {
            if (onDone) onDone();
            return;
        }

        var originalWrite = document.write;
        var originalWriteln = document.writeln;
        var writtenMarkup = '';
        document.write = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup; };
        document.writeln = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup + '\n'; };

        var restoreAndFinish = function() {
            document.write = originalWrite;
            document.writeln = originalWriteln;

            if (writtenMarkup) {
                var writtenContainer = document.createElement('div');
                writtenContainer.innerHTML = writtenMarkup;
                container.appendChild(writtenContainer);
                writtenMarkup = '';
                // the appended markup can carry its own scripts, but they cannot write again
                activatePaywallScripts(writtenContainer, onDone);
                return;
            }

            if (onDone) onDone();
        };

        var runScript = function(index) {
            if (index >= scripts.length) {
                restoreAndFinish();
                return;
            }

            var oldScript = scripts[index];
            var newScript = document.createElement('script');
            for (var i = 0; i < oldScript.attributes.length; i++) {
                newScript.setAttribute(oldScript.attributes[i].name, oldScript.attributes[i].value);
            }

            if (oldScript.src) {
                // wait for the library before running whatever comes next
                newScript.onload = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                newScript.onerror = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
            } else {
                newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
                runScript(index + 1);
            }
        };

        runScript(0);
    }

   // 1. Start observing the entire document for changes
   // childList: detects new elements, subtree: detects changes deep within the DOM tree
   paywallObserver.observe(document.body, {
       childList: true,
       subtree: true
   });

   // 2. Initial execution for elements already present when the page first loads
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallDecryption(el);
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(el);
   });

  // -------------------
  // HAMBURGER MENU

  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');

  function openMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.add('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.remove('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', openMenu);
  if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);


  // -------------------
  // SUBMENU LOGIC (DESKTOP + MOBILE UNIFICATO)
  // -------------------
  if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') {

    jQuery(function ($) {

      const $menu = $('.vc_general_menu_hamburger');

      // -------------------
      // AGGIUNGE FRECCIA AI LI CON SUBMENU
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li').has('ul').each(function () {

        const $li = $(this);

        // evita duplicazioni
        if ($li.children('.submenu-toggle').length === 0) {
          $li.append('<span class="submenu-toggle"></span>');
        }

        // inizialmente chiusi
        $li.children('ul').hide();

      });


      // -------------------
      // TOGGLE SUBMENU (SOLO FRECCIA)
      // -------------------
      $menu.on('click', '.submenu-toggle', function (e) {

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        const $li = $(this).closest('li');
        const $submenu = $li.children('ul');

        // chiude gli altri allo stesso livello
        $li.siblings('li')
          .removeClass('open')
          .children('ul')
          .stop(true, true)
          .slideUp(200);

        // toggle corrente
        if ($li.hasClass('open')) {
          $li.removeClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideUp(200);
        } else {
          $li.addClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideDown(200);
        }

      });

      // -------------------
      // LINK SEMPRE NAVIGAZIONE (NO BLOCCO)
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li > a').on('click', function () {
        // nessun preventDefault â comportamento identico desktop
      });

    });

  }

});
</script>

    /**
    * Dynamic Paywall Handler
    * Automatically detects encrypted article blocks and unlocks them via WebService.
    */

   /**
    * MutationObserver to monitor the DOM for newly injected paywall containers.
    * This is essential for single-page applications or infinite scroll layouts.
    */
   var paywallObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
       mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
           // Iterate through all nodes added to the DOM in this mutation
           for (var i = 0; i < mutation.addedNodes.length; i++) {
               var node = mutation.addedNodes[i];

               // Check if the node is an HTML Element (nodeType 1)
               if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                   // Case A: The injected node is the container itself
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-text-container')) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(node);
                   }
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-media-container')) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(node);
                   }

                   // Case B: The injected node contains one or more paywall containers as children
                   var nestedContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container');
                   nestedContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(container);
                   });
                   var nestedMediaContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container');
                   nestedMediaContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container);
                   });
               }
           }
       });
   });

   /**
    * Core function to handle the decryption process for a single container.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div element containing the preview text.
    */
    function handlePaywallDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        // Retrieve the encrypted text directly from the data attribute of the current container
        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-text');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        // Only proceed if the encrypted string exists
        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            // Prepare data using URLSearchParams to make it compatible with request.getParameter()
            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedText', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) { 
                return response.json(); 
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                
                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedText) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedText;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted');
                }
                
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * Same flow as handlePaywallDecryption, but for the paywalled multimedia content:
    * audio player, video player and gallery. The markup is printed encrypted by
    * /widget/articolo/elementi_articolo.jsp and is restored here only when the canRead
    * call grants the access.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div holding the encrypted player markup.
    */
    function handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedMedia', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) {
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(function(data) {

                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedMedia) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedMedia;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
                    activatePaywallScripts(container, function() {
                        // the mediaelementjs player is started by the consent TagManager on page load,
                        // so a player restored later has to be initialized explicitly
                        if (container.getAttribute('data-player') === 'mediaelementjs' && typeof initPlayer === 'function') {
                            initPlayer(null, null, null);
                        }
                    });
                }

            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Media decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }

   /**
    * The browser never runs the script tags inserted through innerHTML: they have to be
    * recreated to be executed. They run one at a time and in the original order, waiting for
    * each external script, so that an inline script always finds the library it needs.
    * Some player templates still build their markup with document.write, which would wipe the
    * page when called after the load: it is captured and appended to the container instead.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div whose content has just been restored.
    * @param {Function} onDone - Called once every script has been executed.
    */
    function activatePaywallScripts(container, onDone) {
        var scripts = [];
        container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(script) {
            scripts.push(script);
        });

        if (scripts.length === 0) {
            if (onDone) onDone();
            return;
        }

        var originalWrite = document.write;
        var originalWriteln = document.writeln;
        var writtenMarkup = '';
        document.write = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup; };
        document.writeln = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup + '\n'; };

        var restoreAndFinish = function() {
            document.write = originalWrite;
            document.writeln = originalWriteln;

            if (writtenMarkup) {
                var writtenContainer = document.createElement('div');
                writtenContainer.innerHTML = writtenMarkup;
                container.appendChild(writtenContainer);
                writtenMarkup = '';
                // the appended markup can carry its own scripts, but they cannot write again
                activatePaywallScripts(writtenContainer, onDone);
                return;
            }

            if (onDone) onDone();
        };

        var runScript = function(index) {
            if (index >= scripts.length) {
                restoreAndFinish();
                return;
            }

            var oldScript = scripts[index];
            var newScript = document.createElement('script');
            for (var i = 0; i < oldScript.attributes.length; i++) {
                newScript.setAttribute(oldScript.attributes[i].name, oldScript.attributes[i].value);
            }

            if (oldScript.src) {
                // wait for the library before running whatever comes next
                newScript.onload = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                newScript.onerror = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
            } else {
                newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
                runScript(index + 1);
            }
        };

        runScript(0);
    }

   });

       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(el);
   });

  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');

  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');

    if (menu) menu.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.remove('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', openMenu);
  if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);


  // -------------------
  // SUBMENU LOGIC (DESKTOP + MOBILE UNIFICATO)
  // -------------------
  if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') {

    jQuery(function ($) {

      const $menu = $('.vc_general_menu_hamburger');

      // -------------------
      // AGGIUNGE FRECCIA AI LI CON SUBMENU
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li').has('ul').each(function () {

        const $li = $(this);

        // evita duplicazioni
        if ($li.children('.submenu-toggle').length === 0) {
          $li.append('<span class="submenu-toggle"></span>');
        }

        // inizialmente chiusi
        $li.children('ul').hide();

      });


      // -------------------
      // TOGGLE SUBMENU (SOLO FRECCIA)
      // -------------------
      $menu.on('click', '.submenu-toggle', function (e) {

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        const $li = $(this).closest('li');
        const $submenu = $li.children('ul');

        // chiude gli altri allo stesso livello
        $li.siblings('li')
          .removeClass('open')
          .children('ul')
          .stop(true, true)
          .slideUp(200);

        // toggle corrente
        if ($li.hasClass('open')) {
          $li.removeClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideUp(200);
        } else {
          $li.addClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideDown(200);
        }

      });

      // -------------------
      // LINK SEMPRE NAVIGAZIONE (NO BLOCCO)
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li > a').on('click', function () {
        // nessun preventDefault â comportamento identico desktop
      });

    });

  }

});
</script>

<script>
    /**
    * Dynamic Paywall Handler
    * Automatically detects encrypted article blocks and unlocks them via WebService.
    */

   /**
    * MutationObserver to monitor the DOM for newly injected paywall containers.
    * This is essential for single-page applications or infinite scroll layouts.
    */
   var paywallObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
       mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
           // Iterate through all nodes added to the DOM in this mutation
           for (var i = 0; i < mutation.addedNodes.length; i++) {
               var node = mutation.addedNodes[i];

               // Check if the node is an HTML Element (nodeType 1)
               if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                   // Case A: The injected node is the container itself
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-text-container')) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(node);
                   }
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-media-container')) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(node);
                   }

                   // Case B: The injected node contains one or more paywall containers as children
                   var nestedContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container');
                   nestedContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(container);
                   });
                   var nestedMediaContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container');
                   nestedMediaContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container);
                   });
               }
           }
       });
   });

   /**
    * Core function to handle the decryption process for a single container.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div element containing the preview text.
    */
    function handlePaywallDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        // Retrieve the encrypted text directly from the data attribute of the current container
        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-text');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        // Only proceed if the encrypted string exists
        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            // Prepare data using URLSearchParams to make it compatible with request.getParameter()
            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedText', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) { 
                return response.json(); 
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                
                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedText) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedText;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted');
                }
                
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * Same flow as handlePaywallDecryption, but for the paywalled multimedia content:
    * audio player, video player and gallery. The markup is printed encrypted by
    * /widget/articolo/elementi_articolo.jsp and is restored here only when the canRead
    * call grants the access.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div holding the encrypted player markup.
    */
    function handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedMedia', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) {
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(function(data) {

                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedMedia) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedMedia;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
                    activatePaywallScripts(container, function() {
                        // the mediaelementjs player is started by the consent TagManager on page load,
                        // so a player restored later has to be initialized explicitly
                        if (container.getAttribute('data-player') === 'mediaelementjs' && typeof initPlayer === 'function') {
                            initPlayer(null, null, null);
                        }
                    });
                }

            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Media decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * The browser never runs the script tags inserted through innerHTML: they have to be
    * recreated to be executed. They run one at a time and in the original order, waiting for
    * each external script, so that an inline script always finds the library it needs.
    * Some player templates still build their markup with document.write, which would wipe the
    * page when called after the load: it is captured and appended to the container instead.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div whose content has just been restored.
    * @param {Function} onDone - Called once every script has been executed.
    */
    function activatePaywallScripts(container, onDone) {
        var scripts = [];
        container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(script) {
            scripts.push(script);
        });

        if (scripts.length === 0) {
            if (onDone) onDone();
            return;
        }

        var originalWrite = document.write;
        var originalWriteln = document.writeln;
        var writtenMarkup = '';
        document.write = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup; };
        document.writeln = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup + '\n'; };

        var restoreAndFinish = function() {
            document.write = originalWrite;
            document.writeln = originalWriteln;

            if (writtenMarkup) {
                var writtenContainer = document.createElement('div');
                writtenContainer.innerHTML = writtenMarkup;
                container.appendChild(writtenContainer);
                writtenMarkup = '';
                // the appended markup can carry its own scripts, but they cannot write again
                activatePaywallScripts(writtenContainer, onDone);
                return;
            }

            if (onDone) onDone();
        };

        var runScript = function(index) {
            if (index >= scripts.length) {
                restoreAndFinish();
                return;
            }

            var oldScript = scripts[index];
            var newScript = document.createElement('script');
            for (var i = 0; i < oldScript.attributes.length; i++) {
                newScript.setAttribute(oldScript.attributes[i].name, oldScript.attributes[i].value);
            }

            if (oldScript.src) {
                // wait for the library before running whatever comes next
                newScript.onload = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                newScript.onerror = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
            } else {
                newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
                runScript(index + 1);
            }
        };

        runScript(0);
    }

   // 1. Start observing the entire document for changes
   // childList: detects new elements, subtree: detects changes deep within the DOM tree
   paywallObserver.observe(document.body, {
       childList: true,
       subtree: true
   });

   // 2. Initial execution for elements already present when the page first loads
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallDecryption(el);
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(el);
   });
</script>

  // -------------------
  // HAMBURGER MENU
  // -------------------
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');

  function openMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.add('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    if (hamburger) hamburger.classList.remove('active');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', openMenu);
  if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);


  // -------------------
  // SUBMENU LOGIC (DESKTOP + MOBILE UNIFICATO)
  // -------------------
  if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') {

    jQuery(function ($) {

      const $menu = $('.vc_general_menu_hamburger');

      // -------------------
      // AGGIUNGE FRECCIA AI LI CON SUBMENU
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li').has('ul').each(function () {

        const $li = $(this);

        // evita duplicazioni
        if ($li.children('.submenu-toggle').length === 0) {
          $li.append('<span class="submenu-toggle"></span>');
        }

        // inizialmente chiusi
        $li.children('ul').hide();

      });


      // -------------------
      // TOGGLE SUBMENU (SOLO FRECCIA)
      // -------------------
      $menu.on('click', '.submenu-toggle', function (e) {

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        const $li = $(this).closest('li');
        const $submenu = $li.children('ul');

        // chiude gli altri allo stesso livello
        $li.siblings('li')
          .removeClass('open')
          .children('ul')
          .stop(true, true)
          .slideUp(200);

        // toggle corrente
        if ($li.hasClass('open')) {
          $li.removeClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideUp(200);
        } else {
          $li.addClass('open');
          $submenu.stop(true, true).slideDown(200);
        }

      });

      // -------------------
      // LINK SEMPRE NAVIGAZIONE (NO BLOCCO)
      // -------------------
      $menu.find('li > a').on('click', function () {
        // nessun preventDefault â comportamento identico desktop
      });

    });

  }

});

<script>
    /**
    * Dynamic Paywall Handler
    * Automatically detects encrypted article blocks and unlocks them via WebService.
    */

   /**
    * MutationObserver to monitor the DOM for newly injected paywall containers.
    * This is essential for single-page applications or infinite scroll layouts.
    */
   var paywallObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
       mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
           // Iterate through all nodes added to the DOM in this mutation
           for (var i = 0; i < mutation.addedNodes.length; i++) {
               var node = mutation.addedNodes[i];

               // Check if the node is an HTML Element (nodeType 1)
               if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                   // Case A: The injected node is the container itself
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-text-container')) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(node);
                   }
                   if (node.classList.contains('paywall-media-container')) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(node);
                   }

                   // Case B: The injected node contains one or more paywall containers as children
                   var nestedContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container');
                   nestedContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallDecryption(container);
                   });
                   var nestedMediaContainers = node.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container');
                   nestedMediaContainers.forEach(function(container) {
                       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container);
                   });
               }
           }
       });
   });

   /**
    * Core function to handle the decryption process for a single container.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div element containing the preview text.
    */
    function handlePaywallDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        // Retrieve the encrypted text directly from the data attribute of the current container
        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-text');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        // Only proceed if the encrypted string exists
        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            // Prepare data using URLSearchParams to make it compatible with request.getParameter()
            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedText', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) { 
                return response.json(); 
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                
                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedText) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedText;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted');
                }
                
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * Same flow as handlePaywallDecryption, but for the paywalled multimedia content:
    * audio player, video player and gallery. The markup is printed encrypted by
    * /widget/articolo/elementi_articolo.jsp and is restored here only when the canRead
    * call grants the access.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div holding the encrypted player markup.
    */
    function handlePaywallMediaDecryption(container) {
        // Prevent duplicate processing
        if (container.getAttribute('data-processed') === 'true') {
            return;
        }

        var encryptedData = container.getAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
        var contentId = container.getAttribute('data-id');

        if (encryptedData) {
            container.setAttribute('data-processed', 'true');

            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.append('articleId', contentId);
            params.append('encryptedMedia', encryptedData);
            params.append('date', container.getAttribute('data-date'));
            params.append('productId', container.getAttribute('data-product'));
            params.append('title', container.getAttribute('data-title'));
            params.append('_', new Date().getTime()); // Adding the cache-buster manually for safety

            fetch('/webservices/canRead.jsp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    // This header is MANDATORY for request.getParameter to work in Java
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: params.toString()
            })
            .then(function(response) {
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(function(data) {

                if (data && data.canRead === true && data.decryptedMedia) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.decryptedMedia;
                    container.classList.add('paywall-unlocked');
                    container.removeAttribute('data-encrypted-media');
                    activatePaywallScripts(container, function() {
                        // the mediaelementjs player is started by the consent TagManager on page load,
                        // so a player restored later has to be initialized explicitly
                        if (container.getAttribute('data-player') === 'mediaelementjs' && typeof initPlayer === 'function') {
                            initPlayer(null, null, null);
                        }
                    });
                }

            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Media decryption error for ID: ' + contentId, error);
                container.removeAttribute('data-processed');
            });
        }
    }

   /**
    * The browser never runs the script tags inserted through innerHTML: they have to be
    * recreated to be executed. They run one at a time and in the original order, waiting for
    * each external script, so that an inline script always finds the library it needs.
    * Some player templates still build their markup with document.write, which would wipe the
    * page when called after the load: it is captured and appended to the container instead.
    * @param {HTMLElement} container - The div whose content has just been restored.
    * @param {Function} onDone - Called once every script has been executed.
    */
    function activatePaywallScripts(container, onDone) {
        var scripts = [];
        container.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(script) {
            scripts.push(script);
        });

        if (scripts.length === 0) {
            if (onDone) onDone();
            return;
        }

        var originalWrite = document.write;
        var originalWriteln = document.writeln;
        var writtenMarkup = '';
        document.write = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup; };
        document.writeln = function(markup) { writtenMarkup += markup + '\n'; };

        var restoreAndFinish = function() {
            document.write = originalWrite;
            document.writeln = originalWriteln;

            if (writtenMarkup) {
                var writtenContainer = document.createElement('div');
                writtenContainer.innerHTML = writtenMarkup;
                container.appendChild(writtenContainer);
                writtenMarkup = '';
                // the appended markup can carry its own scripts, but they cannot write again
                activatePaywallScripts(writtenContainer, onDone);
                return;
            }

            if (onDone) onDone();
        };

        var runScript = function(index) {
            if (index >= scripts.length) {
                restoreAndFinish();
                return;
            }

            var oldScript = scripts[index];
            var newScript = document.createElement('script');
            for (var i = 0; i < oldScript.attributes.length; i++) {
                newScript.setAttribute(oldScript.attributes[i].name, oldScript.attributes[i].value);
            }

            if (oldScript.src) {
                // wait for the library before running whatever comes next
                newScript.onload = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                newScript.onerror = function() { runScript(index + 1); };
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
            } else {
                newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
                oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
                runScript(index + 1);
            }
        };

        runScript(0);
    }

   // 1. Start observing the entire document for changes
   // childList: detects new elements, subtree: detects changes deep within the DOM tree
   paywallObserver.observe(document.body, {
       childList: true,
       subtree: true
   });

   // 2. Initial execution for elements already present when the page first loads
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-text-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallDecryption(el);
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('.paywall-media-container').forEach(function(el) {
       handlePaywallMediaDecryption(el);
   });
